confidence_notes: Restaurant, cappuccino, and draft beer anchors use a current Panama City cost-of-living index (last updated 2026-10-15). Cocktail and wine prices are bounded estimates based on their usual local price relationship to draft beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates and are less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use city-level Panama City price data; accommodation reflects a broad estimate for a Central American capital with business and visitor demand.
